description: Resumable tracker for the webauthn-server-buildkit v2.2.0 polish: dependency updates, full security/code audit, fixes, docs, and npm release. The first phase/sub-task with status 'pending' or 'in_progress' is the next thing to work on. Re-running the originating prompt MUST read this file and resume from the first non-complete sub-task — never restart from scratch.

userDecisions.mobileAttestation: Opt-in via enableMobileAttestation config flag, default OFF. Standard WebAuthn path only unless explicitly enabled. Loud warnings + docs when enabled (no cryptographic attestation guarantee).
userDecisions.cryptoTests: APPROVED to add real round-trip regression tests (overrides the standing no-tests-unless-asked rule, scoped to this security work).
userDecisions.versioning: Minor 2.2.0. Document in CHANGELOG that existing session tokens are invalidated on upgrade (one-time re-auth) and that mobile-attestation default changed.
userDecisions.majorDeps: Attempt ESLint 9->10 and TypeScript 5.9->6.0; verify toolchain works together; pin back only if the plugin ecosystem does not yet support them, documenting why.

knownRisks: TypeScript 6.0 may surface new strict type errors in src/.
ESLint 10 may not yet be supported by typescript-eslint 8.x (peer range) — may need to hold at ESLint 9 latest.
Switching session KDF (HKDF) invalidates existing session tokens on deploy — documented, acceptable per user decision.
JWK-based key import requires Node >=18; engine is >=24.13.0 so safe.
Full multi-format attestation (tpm/android-safetynet/apple) is large; this release scopes to none + packed + fido-u2f, others explicitly flagged unverified.
commitPolicy: ONE commit per completed+verified phase (green checkpoint), tracker update included in the same commit. This maximizes resumability for this large multi-session task. Push after committing (authorized by project CLAUDE.md). npm publish requires explicit user confirmation at Phase 6.

runHistory.summary: Read entire codebase, established green baseline, compiled full audit (findings.md), confirmed 3 product decisions with user, scaffolded resumable plan/tracker.

Updated all deps to latest stable incl. majors ESLint 10.4.0 + TypeScript 6.0.3 (verified typescript-eslint 8.60.0 peers support both). Rewrote eslint.config.js with typescript-eslint flat config (removed banned @eslint/js, wired TS plugin, no-unused-vars error, prettier integration). tsconfig: types:['node'], ignoreDeprecations '6.0', paths ./src/*. Dropped --ext from lint scripts. Normalized repo formatting (prettier 3.8.3). Gate green: typecheck/lint/test(131)/build/format all clean.

newFindings: CI-1 [low]: .github/workflows/ci.yml tests Node 20.x/22.x but package engine requires >=24.13.0 — bump CI matrix to 24.x (Phase 04/05).

resumeInstructions: 1) Read this tracker. 2) Read progress.md + findings.md. 3) Find the first phase/sub-task with status 'pending' or 'in_progress'. 4) Read that phase's .md file. 5) Invoke matching skills per RULE #0 (security-review, vitest, nodejs-best-practices, documentation-writer, simplify as relevant). 6) Do the work, run the verification gate, mark sub-tasks complete, append a runHistory row, bump lastUpdated. 7) ONE commit per completed+verified phase including the tracker update. 8) Do NOT npm publish without explicit user confirmation (phase06.4).
